Definition
[thick--thin decomposition] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Definition 4\group Kleiner–Lott Long-Time Topology

The $w$-thin part $M^-(w, t) \subset \M _t^+$ is the set of points $x \in M$ so that either $\rho (x,t)=\infty $ or \begin{equation} \vol (B(x, t, \rho (x, t))) \: < \: w \: (\rho (x, t))^3. \end{equation} The $w$-thick part is $M^+(w, t) = \M _t^+ - M^-(w, t)$.

Lemma
[existence for thick--thin geometry]
